description: Team-to-team game traffic. Sort active directions by load; select a pair for totals and history.
title: ForcAD - Game traffic

panels.title: Capture status
panels.description: Configured sensors only. No targets means the sensor is not installed.

panels.title: Heartbeat age
panels.description: A heartbeat older than 45 seconds excludes the sensor from game panels.

panels.title: Capture drops/s
panels.description: System capture drops; nonzero values can mean incomplete counts.

panels.title: Stream gaps/s
panels.description: Missing TCP stream data, including capture loss or unseen directions.

panels.title: Active directions - last minute
panels.description: Click a team name to select the pair; sort columns by load. Inactive pairs are hidden; missing metrics show N/A. Same-team rows mean own-box access. High load alone does not prove a violation.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (source_team_ip, team_ip) (rate(forcad_game_http_requests_total{source_team_ip=~"${source}",team_ip=~"${target}"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) forcad:game_sensor_ready))

panels.title: Game HTTP requests/s
panels.description: Observed plaintext HTTP/1 requests for the selection, including upgrades. All -> All is the game total.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (source_team_ip, team_ip) (forcad_game_websocket_connections{source_team_ip=~"${source}",team_ip=~"${target}"} and on (job, instance) forcad:game_sensor_ready))

panels.title: Open game WebSockets
panels.description: Observed WS upgrades until TCP close/reset or five idle minutes, summed for the selection.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (source_team_ip, team_ip) ((rate(forcad_network_source_packets_total{job="forcad_router",team_ip=~"${target}"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) (forcad_network_source_scrape_success == 1 and on (job, instance) up == 1)) * on (source_ip) group_left (source_team_ip) forcad:game_peer_info{source_team_ip=~"${source}"}))

panels.title: VPN -> vulnbox packets/s
panels.description: Selected VPN peer -> vulnbox packets after router filtering, before SNAT; includes non-game ports.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (source_team_ip, team_ip) (forcad_game_tcp_connections{source_team_ip=~"${source}",team_ip=~"${target}"} and on (job, instance) forcad:game_sensor_ready))

panels.title: Established TCP connections
panels.description: Observed established TCP connections until close/reset or five idle minutes, summed for the selection.

targets.expr: sum(8 * (sum by (source_team_ip, team_ip) ((rate(forcad_network_source_bytes_total{job="forcad_router",team_ip=~"${target}"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) (forcad_network_source_scrape_success == 1 and on (job, instance) up == 1)) * on (source_ip) group_left (source_team_ip) forcad:game_peer_info{source_team_ip=~"${source}"})))

panels.title: VPN -> vulnbox bandwidth
panels.description: Selected VPN peer -> vulnbox bandwidth after router filtering, before SNAT; includes non-game ports.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (source_team_ip, team_ip) (rate(forcad_game_tcp_flows_total{source_team_ip=~"${source}",team_ip=~"${target}"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) forcad:game_sensor_ready))

panels.title: New TCP flows/s
panels.description: Observed new TCP flows for the selection, including incomplete handshakes.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (source_team_ip, team_ip) (rate(forcad_game_udp_flows_total{source_team_ip=~"${source}",team_ip=~"${target}"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) forcad:game_sensor_ready))

panels.title: New UDP flows/s
panels.description: Observed new UDP flows for the selection; 60-second idle timeout. Not application request rate.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (source_team_ip, team_ip) (rate(forcad_game_websocket_upgrades_total{source_team_ip=~"${source}",team_ip=~"${target}"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) forcad:game_sensor_ready))

panels.title: New WebSocket connections/s
panels.description: Observed HTTP 101 upgrades to WebSocket for the selection.
